name: Default
shortDescription: Digital photo frame web app that shows a slideshow from your Immich library, with clock, weather and calendar overlays and a browser admin UI.

alerts.message: ImmichFrame needs an existing Immich v3.3.0 or newer server and an Immich API key. Open /admin, sign in with IMMICHFRAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables, then add the Immich server URL and API key under Accounts.
The slideshow is public by default: anyone with the URL can see the photos it shows. Set AuthenticationSecret in the admin UI and open the frame with ?authsecret=<secret> to restrict it.
